Implementation complete. Here is my report for Codex / the environment owner.

## Changed paths
- `parse.mjs`
- `aggregate.mjs`
- `cli.mjs`

These are the only files created/modified. `visible-test.mjs` is unchanged, and no other files were touched.

## Actual visible-test result
Command: `node visible-test.mjs` → printed `3 visible assertions passed` (exit 0). Ran exactly once; it passed, so no product-defect fix / rerun was needed.

## Notes on behavior implemented (for independent integration verification)
- **parse.mjs** — `parseJobs(text)` throws `TypeError` for non-string input. Strips a single leading BOM; splits on LF/CRLF/CR; ignores blank lines while still advancing physical line numbers; classifies per line as `INVALID_JSON` (JSON.parse failure) → `SCHEMA` (non-object/array/null, or bad id/durationMs/status) → `DUPLICATE_ID` (valid later record whose id was already accepted). Schema validation precedes duplicate detection. Invalid records never reserve ids; first valid record per id is kept in input order; errors are `{line, code}` only; extra fields are omitted.
- **aggregate.mjs** — `summarizeJobs(jobs)` returns `{total, succeeded, failed, skipped, durationMs, medianSuccessMs, slowest}`. `durationMs` sums succeeded+failed only; `medianSuccessMs` is the success-only median (avg of middle pair for even counts, `low + (high-low)/2` to avoid overflow), `0` when none; `slowest` is top-3 non-skipped normalized records ordered duration desc then ASCII id asc; inputs/objects never mutated (copies sorted).
- **cli.mjs** — requires exactly 2 args and rejects equal resolved input/output paths before any FS change; reads INPUT fully before creating dirs/temp; recursively mkdirs the output parent; publishes via an exclusively created (`wx`) uniquely named sibling temp file + `rename`; never pre-deletes/truncates existing OUTPUT; removes only its owned temp on failure; writes `JSON.stringify({summary, errors}, null, 2) + "\n"`; exit 0 on valid-only input (incl. empty file), exit 2 when parser errors exist (report still published), exit 1 on argument/read/write failure with a concise, sanitized stderr message; nothing to stdout.

## Unresolved product defects
None identified. No integration/child-process work was attempted; this scope ran only `node visible-test.mjs` as instructed.
